item.title: Burrell girls clinch playoff spot with win over rival Freeport
item.description: The Burrell girls basketball team was comfortably in contention for a WPIAL playoff spot heading into its Section 1-4A matchup Thursday at Freeport.

item.title: Mexico’s Sheinbaum reiterates sovereignty in Trump call after Olympic snowboarder detained
item.description: MEXICO CITY — Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum reiterated that operations on Mexican soil are always carried out by Mexican forces, in her latest attempt to assuage concerns of U.S. encroachment on Mexican sovereignty.

item.description: Sidney Crosby is well educated on winning.

item.title: New cold snap adds urgency to winter storm recovery across the South
item.description: BELZONI, Miss. — Hundreds of National Guard troops in ice-stricken Mississippi and Tennessee mobilized Thursday to clear debris and assist people stranded in cars or stuck at homes still without electricity as Southern states raced to recover from a crippling winter storm before another blast of dangerous cold hits.

item.title: Trump sues IRS and Treasury for $10 billion over leaked tax info
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump is suing the IRS and Treasury Department for $10 billion, as he accuses the federal agencies of a failure to prevent a leak of the president’s tax information to news outlets between 2018 and 2020.

item.title: WPIAL clinched: Girls basketball playoff qualifiers through Jan. 29, 2026
item.description: The 2026 WPIAL girls basketball regular season is down to a little over week left as the district playoff field is starting to take shape with 50 teams having punched their ticket to participate in the February Frenzy.

item.title: Martinelli scores 34, Singleton has a double-double as Northwestern downs Penn State 94-73
item.description: EVANSTON, Ill. — Nick Martinelli scored 34 points, and Tre Singleton notched a massive double-double as Northwestern beat Penn State, 94-73, on Thursday night.

item.title: High school roundup for Jan. 29, 2026: Geibel Catholic’s Emma Larkin threatens WPIAL single-game scoring record
item.description: Emma Larkin scored the second-most points in a game in WPIAL girls basketball history Thursday night, finishing with 62 in a 106-19 Geibel Catholic victory over Mapletown (2-17, 1-10) in Section 2-A.
